clue.text: He flies a good deal

parts.note: PI, short for pious, is the crossword stand-in for good
a deal, as in 'a good deal of', means a lot

explanation.surface: A man who flies gets a bargain, perhaps cheap air fares.
explanation.definitionFit: An aviator is the person who flies an aircraft.

clue.text: Give the call-sign

parts.note: not a radio operator's identifier but a gesture: signalling to someone with a hand that they should come over

explanation.definitionFit: To summon someone with a wave is literally to give them a sign that calls them.

clue.text: Summed up as a tale told inaccurately

indicators.note: a tale told inaccurately has its letters set down in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A summary that is really just a story recounted carelessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inaccurately' rearranges the eight letters of TALE TOLD; 'as a' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Adding up figures to reach a sum is the same as working out their total.

clue.text: They are made to scale

parts.note: reads like scale models built in proportion, but means things built for climbing up

explanation.definitionFit: To scale a wall is to climb it, and rungs on rails exist for climbing.

clue.text: They are paid by formal visitors

definitions.text: They are paid by formal visitors

parts.words: They are paid by formal visitors
parts.note: sounds like fees or bills, but refers to the idiom of a courtesy call: one pays these when visiting formally

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'pay one's respects' means to make a polite, formal visit.

clue.text: A show trial

parts.note: evokes a staged political prosecution, but means a trial run of a stage show

explanation.definitionFit: A practice performance before opening night is a trial of the show.

clue.text: When it is, the creditor may not allow it

definitions.text: When it is, the creditor may not allow it

parts.words: When it is, the creditor may not allow it
parts.note: a debtor's due date: when the moment to settle arrives, a lender will not grant more time

explanation.definitionFit: The moment a debt falls due is when a lender refuses any further delay.

clue.text: It is even palindromic

indicators.note: palindromic says the word wanted reads the same from either end

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A remark that something is both flat and a palindrome.
explanation.definitionFit: Flat and smooth, with no rise or fall, as a surface can be even.

clue.text: Experts in cards

definitions.meaning: top performers in any field, such as star pilots
the highest-ranking playing cards in each suit

explanation.surface: Skilled players at a card table.
explanation.definitionFit: Champions in a field are called this, and the one-pip playing cards share the name.

clue.text: Measure following cut in naval establishment

indicators.note: following says the measure comes after the word for cut

parts.note: to dock a tail is to cut it short
a yard is a measure of length, three feet

explanation.surface: A budget measure brought in after cuts at a navy base.
explanation.definitionFit: A shipbuilding and repair yard run for the navy is a naval base.

clue.text: Firm support for item of office equipment

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation of company, a firm
a pier is a pillar supporting a bridge or arch

explanation.surface: A company backing a particular piece of office kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A photocopying machine is standard equipment in an office.

clue.text: A Northern Island lake a blue-violet colour

parts.note: I is the map abbreviation for island
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A lake on a northern island has a striking blue-violet hue.
explanation.definitionFit: Anil is the indigo plant and the deep blue dye made from it.

clue.text: Taken by those who are sick and tired of work?

definitions.text: Taken by those who are sick and tired of work?

parts.words: Taken by those who are sick and tired of work?
parts.note: the idiom 'sick and tired' read literally: people who are ill and exhausted undergo a course of recuperation

explanation.definitionFit: A regime of bed rest prescribed for invalids or the exhausted.

clue.text: Games pitch out in the garden

indicators.note: out says the word for pitch is spread out around the word for games

parts.note: to shy is to throw or pitch something
a rubber is a set of games, as in bridge or tennis

explanation.surface: Ball games are thrown out into the garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link: the plantings are found in the garden. Bridge players call a best-of-three set of games a rubber.
explanation.definitionFit: A planted area of bushes forms part of a garden.

clue.text: Word play

parts.note: not punning but a parlour game in which a word is acted out, a play on a word

explanation.definitionFit: The parlour game where teams mime a word syllable by syllable for others to guess.

clue.text: An editor fiddled when on an allowance

indicators.note: fiddled suggests the letters of an editor were tampered with and rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor cooks the books while on a fixed expense allowance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddled' rearranges AN EDITOR; 'when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Being kept to a fixed allocation means supplies are limited by rationing.

clue.text: Revolutionary means of power on board

definitions.text: Revolutionary means of power on board

parts.words: Revolutionary means of power on board
parts.note: hints at a political coup in a boardroom, but means a turning winch on a ship's deck

explanation.definitionFit: A rotating drum on a ship's deck, turned by bars, hauls in cables and anchors.

clue.text: Dilatory perhaps, but performed with skill

indicators.note: perhaps hints that dilatory may stand for some other ordering of its letters

explanation.surface: Slow, maybe, but the job was done skilfully.
explanation.definitionFit: Done deftly and cleverly, with nimble hands.

clue.text: Masses of people moving about in the morning in the streets

indicators.note: the second in places the pieces inside the abbreviation for streets

parts.note: STS abbreviates streets, as ST is street
RE is Latin for about, concerning
AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

explanation.surface: Crowds bustling around town during the morning rush.
explanation.definitionFit: Crowds flowing steadily in one direction are said to pour in streams.

clue.text: Result of division not quite correct

indicators.note: correct as a verb: put the letters of not quite right by rearranging them

explanation.surface: A sum's answer that is slightly wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: In arithmetic, dividing one number by another gives this figure.

clue.text: Falls in the sea

parts.note: suggests tumbling overboard, but means the sea level going down as the tide recedes

explanation.definitionFit: The tide's outward retreat, when sea level drops.

clue.text: Uses the knuckles to fight back

indicators.note: back says the word for fight is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: to spar is to box or fight

explanation.surface: A boxer uses his fists to retaliate.
explanation.definitionFit: Knocking sharply with the knuckles, as on a door.

clue.text: A steep fluctuation in currency

indicators.note: fluctuation suggests the letters of a steep rise and fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A sharp swing in the value of money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fluctuation' rearranges A STEEP; 'in' is a link. The peseta was Spain's money before the euro.
explanation.definitionFit: The former monetary unit of Spain.

clue.text: Teachings that follow closely on a degree

indicators.note: on says the first piece sits upon the second in this down answer

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely
MA, Master of Arts, is a degree

explanation.surface: Lessons that come straight after a university degree.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctrine laid down as true by an authority, such as a church.

clue.text: Take in the sailor's world

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor; with the possessive it becomes ABS
an orb is a sphere, a globe or world

explanation.surface: Learn about the life a seaman leads.
explanation.definitionFit: To soak up or assimilate, as a sponge does with water.

clue.text: Oriental girl on a charge that is thrown out

indicators.note: on says the last piece follows directly after the others

parts.note: E, for east, stands for oriental
a miss is a young unmarried woman
an ion is a charged particle

explanation.surface: An Eastern girl facing a criminal charge sees her case dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something discharged or given off, like exhaust fumes from a car.

clue.text: Instruction must be concise

definitions.meaning: a set of instructions given to a lawyer or agent

explanation.definitionFit: A barrister's instructions are this, and the same word means short.

clue.text: Working steam-mill of no great importance

indicators.note: working suggests the letters of steam-mill are worked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An old steam-powered mill still running, though of little significance.
explanation.definitionFit: Minor and unimportant, as a petty operator is in a small way of business.
